_about: Sources read 2 October 2026 for the war memorial sourcing pilot (inventory/review/war-memorial-sourcing-2026-10-02.md; Nathan approved the pilot and the three federal source sets). NARA AAD records read in a browser (aad.archives.gov refuses scripted requests); the 1946 Honor List page images downloaded from the NARA catalog to inventory/legacy/fetched/nara-honor-list-ca/ and read by eye; the DoD release read from the Internet Archive copy of defenselink.mil; the archive's own documents read from web/uploads/archive-media/legacy/.

draftCard.source: World War I Selective Service draft registration card, Edward Guy North, Nye County, Nevada, registered June 5, 1917 (NARA, Record Group 163); archive asset wwi_edwardguynorth_draft.jpg

honorRoll.source: California War History Committee, State Council of Defense, California's Honor Roll card for Corp. Edward Guy North, signed by Mary E. North, dated 9/20/20; archive asset wwi_edwardguynorth_honorroll.jpg

reads.note: shot while in charge of machine-gun in the fighting at Epmonville in the battle of Monfacon; immediate cause surgical shock from operation, result of wound

laTimes.source: Los Angeles Times, April 9, 1919, "For Argonne Hero", transcribed on the record (wmServiceExtra) and archive asset lat19190409north.jpg

reads.died: at Camp Kearny, Monday, from surgical shock
reads.unit: Company D., Machine Gun Battalion 347, Ninety-first Division

laTimes.note: Monday before Wednesday April 9, 1919 is April 7, 1919.

1384 Edward Guy North.federalDeathRecord: None found online. A World War I death in a domestic camp is not in ABMC; the War Department's burial case files are not online. The rule's federal source is not met; the draft card is federal but records registration, not death.

honorList.source: War Department, World War II Honor List of Dead and Missing Army and Army Air Forces Personnel from California (1946), Los Angeles County, NARA NAID 305280, image 28-2506a

enlistment.source: NARA, World War II Army Enlistment Records (RG 64), Electronic Army Serial Number Merged File, serial 39730703

signal.source: The Newhall Signal, March 24, 1949, "Soldier is borne to last resting place among own native hills"; archive asset sg032449_large.jpg

reads.burial: the little Ruiz burying ground in San Francisquito Canyon
reads.honors: Castaic Legion Post; Sixth Army escort firing squad

reportOfDeath.source: War Department, The Adjutant General's Office, Final Report of Death No. 5295, Henry Acuna, 23 October 1950 (WD AGO Form 52-1); archive asset korea_henryacuna_deathcert.jpg

reads.mia: missing in action from 31 July 1950 until 14 October 1950

rg407.source: NARA, Korean War Casualty File (RG 407), Army

caccf.source: NARA, Combat Area Casualties Current File (RG 330), reference 21411

coffelt.source: The Coffelt Database, December 2005 Update (NARA, Collection COFF)

reads.unit: C Trp, 3rd Sqd, 5th Cavalry, 9th Inf Div

reads.awards: the Bronze Star and the Bronze Star with the "V" Device (First Oak Leaf Cluster)
reads.unit: Troop C, third Squadron fifth Calvary, Quang Tri Province

dodRelease.source: Department of Defense, News Release No. 1179-04, "DoD Identifies Army Casualty," November 17, 2004, http://www.defenselink.mil/releases/2004/nr20041117-1549.html, read in the Internet Archive copy of December 28, 2004

reads.text: Pfc. Cole W. Larsen, 19, of Canyon Country, Calif., died Nov. 13 in Baghdad, Iraq, when a civilian vehicle struck his military vehicle causing it to roll over. Larsen was assigned to the 272nd Military Police Company, 21st Theater Support Command, Mannheim, Germany.

dcas.source: NARA, Defense Casualty Analysis System (DCAS) Public Use File, 1950-2005 (RG 330)

reads.home: Canyon Country, Los Angeles County, California

cenotaph.source: Photograph of Cole Larsen's cenotaph marker; archive asset colelarsencenotaph.jpg. Its place, Eternal Valley Cemetery, Newhall, is from the legacy page; the photograph does not show it.

reads.text: COLE WILLIAM LARSEN / PFC US ARMY IRAQ / MAY [day obscured] 1985 / NOV 13 2004 / BRONZE STAR MEDAL / OPERATION IRAQI FREEDOM
